name: yug-of-automata-workspace
description: A local RTS dashboard for your AI coding automata.
author: SUDARSHANCHAUDHARI

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/shared build && pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/server build && pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/client build && node scripts/build-release.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/shared build && pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/shared test && pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/server test && pnpm --filter @yug-of-automata/client test && pnpm --filter yug-of-automata test
